iteration_contract: Read freeze, boundary and current state first.
Search only official Binance Support/CMS public read-only sources for new Launchpool announcements strictly after boundary_utc.
Validate canonical article code, publication timestamp and explicit BNB staking/locking/farming pool evidence before eligibility.
Never use pre-boundary announcements, duplicates, reposts or non-Launchpool products.
Cluster eligible announcements within <=60 minutes and select earliest canonical timestamp.
If a selected cluster overlaps an active 24h paper trade, suppress it exactly as frozen.
For a selected non-overlapping event, record paper entry as the first BNBBTC 15m bar open strictly after signal timestamp; record exit at the bar open exactly 24h later.
Use only public read-only market data; no API keys, orders, wallets, authenticated endpoints, alerts, webhooks or exchange mutation.
Fail closed if event provenance, entry bar, exit bar, timestamps or data continuity are ambiguous or missing.
Persist state append-only by event identity; never rewrite a resolved trade except to correct a proven byte/technical transcription error with an explicit audit trail.
At 10 resolved trades compute report-only checkpoint; no tier change.
At 25 resolved trades evaluate exactly the frozen Tier-2 Path-2 gates; no tuning or rescue.
notify_only_on: new paper trade selected or overlap-suppressed
